name: Founder decision: Settle ownership of the OS surface between the two seated founders
text_content:
The white paper assigns Brandon "the concept, the operating systems, and the experience" (WP p. 03) and Dominic "the capital, the financial architecture, and the technology build" plus "the data architecture" (WP pp. 03, 05). It then describes the stack's proprietary layer as "the OS surface and the agent layer" (WP p. 22). No founder is named as its owner, and the two stated domains land on the same object.

This is the boundary the founder job description carryover (86ajgnhp7) exists to prevent: a CEO and a CFO/CTO quietly both owning the same thing until it breaks under load.

Options: Brandon owns the specification (what the surface must do, what the agents decide, what a lead sees) and Dominic owns the build and operation, with a stated request path for anything outside the specification; or one seat owns it outright.

Requires both founders. Filed by Session 2. Reasoning is in section 7 of the S2 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
